certifications.name: AWS Solutions Architect – Associate
certifications.shortDesc: Core AWS services and architecture patterns
certifications.fullDesc: The most popular AWS certification. Covers core services across compute, storage, networking, databases, security and architecture best practices using the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

certifications.name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
certifications.fullDesc: Hands-on exam that validates your ability to deploy, manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters. Covers cluster architecture, workloads, networking, storage and security at the admin level.

certifications.name: AWS Machine Learning Specialty
certifications.shortDesc: Building, training, and deploying ML models on AWS
certifications.fullDesc: Validates expertise in building, training, tuning and deploying ML models on AWS. Covers SageMaker, data engineering, exploratory data analysis and ML implementation at scale.
